summary: Navigate descriptions with arrow keys throughout the reader

examined.reason: Arrow navigation is now a reader-wide interaction, including with the bottom menu folded. The broader reading and source behavior is unchanged.

Replaced the menu-focus condition with window-wide ordinary arrow navigation. Extracted shared neighborhood lookup and movement from menu rendering, preserved folded state, removed duplicate arrow handling, and retained hierarchy boundaries and existing selection validation.
Documented and implemented arrow priority for focused form controls, text editing, composing input and modified shortcuts. The keyboard handler ignores events already handled by a control.
The root promises navigation between intent, detail and implementation without prescribing focus requirements.
Stable identities and parent relationships already supply the neighborhood used by both keyboard and menu navigation. No model change is needed.
Exact quote resolution is unaffected; updated the selectors for revised prose and moved code.
An opened target still constructs the same parent/active-child pair and preserves the common parent scroll position. The trigger for opening changed, not the pairing rules.
The same sandboxed renderer and restricted API process navigation. No IPC, project selection, permissions, source parsing or styling changes are necessary.
Tests and Problems retain their display behavior. Ordinary arrows can return from these supporting views to the adjacent active description via existing navigation.
Highlighting remains independent of navigation focus and menu visibility; the smoke retains repeated-toggle and navigation checks.
Arrow navigation from source uses the same description-open operation as a clicked destination; source closes and the target parent/child pair is shown.
Passage follow behavior is unchanged. The current active identity remains the starting point for keyboard navigation even after source is opened from the parent.

results.method: npm run typecheck; npm run test:desktop; node src/cli.ts --project . validate; bounded implementation review
results.evidence: Typecheck and description/link validation pass. Desktop smoke passes with equal before/after snapshots. It covers arrows from prose, toolbar and source; continued navigation with a folded menu; no forced menu focus; root/leaf boundaries; modified arrows; native revision-selector event handling; text editing; existing paired scrolling, menu-focused arrows, 300 leaves, source syntax, history, project selection, highlighting and sandbox behavior. Output: /private/tmp/stratic-arrows-smoke.txt.

unmapped.reason: Inspected removal of separate mutable menu cursor/context state and the new document key handler. Neighborhood is derived from the active selection; global keys use the existing open operation, preserve panel visibility, and defer to native editing controls and modified shortcuts.
